title: MyScrollDeployment
tagline: Simple contract for Scroll test deployment, Scroll example usage
description: Simple contract for Scroll test deployment, Scroll example usage to get familiar with docs and zkEVM. As far as I'm concerned, the documentation is clear and concise, making it easy and enjoyable to learn about the underlying technology yet simple to test it. This was motivating to dive deeper into zkEVM application development on Scroll.
how_its_made: Scroll example can be found here https://github.com/scroll-tech/scroll-contract-deploy-demo, the code was slightly modified, the goal was familiarity with the documentation. I used Foundry as depicted in the above Scroll example link. The project doesn't do anything but functionality also wasn't the accomplishment I was aiming for here.
